items.summary: Agent results declare totalCount and truncated; dataset coverage keeps unknown window starts null instead of inventing dates.
A position-update handler calls .get on the positions list, so the exception path can log a failed event while the WebSocket stays connected.
The claimed pairs strategy computes its second price from the first by default and orders only one leg.
Backtest jobs have terminal result files, but a crash before completion leaves no persisted record of the accepted in-flight job.
The quarterly winner is shifted, yet missing open prices can be backward-filled from later dates before the execution replay.
